# ThumbGate

> Stripe Connect integration engineering for ticketing and marketplace platforms — shipped to Hilltown Media on Pretix. ThumbGate is also the pre-action governance runtime for AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI): thumbs-down feedback becomes history-aware lessons and PreToolUse checks that block repeated mistakes before the next tool call.

## Core

- [Pretix + Stripe Connect Marketplaces (Hilltown case study)](https://thumbgate.ai/learn/pretix-stripe-connect-marketplaces): How a multi-venue Stripe Connect plugin was shipped on Pretix with venues as Merchant of Record. M1 $1,350 net + M2 $900 net + M3 $1,500 escrow funded.
- [Pricing](https://thumbgate.ai/pricing): Free local CLI, Pro $19/mo or $149/yr, Workflow Hardening Sprint (intake-led).
- [Pro checkout](https://thumbgate.ai/checkout/pro): Personal enforcement proof, local dashboard, DPO export.
- [Setup guide](https://thumbgate.ai/guide): `npx thumbgate init` for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, Amp, OpenCode.
- [Comparison](https://thumbgate.ai/compare): vs CLAUDE.md, ESLint, manual code review, Mem0, SpecLock.
- [About](https://thumbgate.ai/about): Founder context and positioning.
- [Full LLM context](https://thumbgate.ai/llm-context.md): Long-form machine-readable description.

## Stripe Connect & Marketplace Engineering

- [Pretix + Stripe Connect plugin (Hilltown case study)](https://thumbgate.ai/learn/pretix-stripe-connect-marketplaces): Direct Charges, application_fee_amount, multi-venue MoR architecture.
